verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an official llms.txt at docs.statsig.com that returns HTTP 200 and is headed 'Statsig Documentation'. Statsig also documents a dedicated Docs MCP server that lets AI clients read its public documentation directly from /api/mcp, which is agent-oriented docs access beyond a static file. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the Docs MCP server, and evidence on the depth of the llms.txt content beyond its header.
